artist.name: Unnayanaa
artist.bio: Unnayanaa is the project of Bangalore DJ and producer Prashanth Pallemoni, whose music draws on Afrobeat, house, jazz and Brazilian rhythms. He has released on Rainy City Music, Borders Of Light, Wind Horse Records and his own label Alternate Art Forms, including tracks built from recordings made in Ethiopia and Congo. He has hosted the monthly show Syncopate on boxout.fm and debuted his Osmosis live show at Magnetic Fields in 2023.
